items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: he remembered seeing me on the streets when I had been here ten years ago... we talked about that and reminisced a little bit

ctx.x: I think of him as the other one. That might have been... The guy was a saxophone player, if you believe. That might have been who it was. One of the things that I remember, but going to that parade at one point, there was a little handful of white people who were there, that one of the musicians spotted me and came over and spoke to me and acted as if he knew me. And I didn't disabuse him. But it turns out that really he remembered seeing me on the streets when I had been here ten years ago, and I was a familiar…
Chuck Fortier. Yeah. He was always telling me that, and I never will.
He is kind of a funny guy. But I do remember that... Yeah.
